items.description: Huw Pill calls last week’s quarter-point increase to 4% a ‘significant step’ but that there was ‘further to go’ with borrowing costs

items.description: Opportunities in China lie as much in the picks and shovels of the AI supply chain

items.description: It is worth paying attention to the warning signs of corporate hubris — they often mean something bad is about to happen

items.title: Where jazz goes to church
items.description: For a decade, an east London church has hosted some of the world’s most adventurous jazz musicians. Now Church of Sound is taking its worship to the Barbican for this week’s London Jazz Festival

items.title: A ‘Generational Clash’ Is Fueling Europe’s Protests
items.description: As retirees live longer, governments need to spend more on pensions. That makes it harder to fund other services, spurring protests like those planned this weekend in France.

items.title: Trump Administration Delays Enforcement of Medicaid Work Requirement
items.description: The federal government had planned to require poor adults to prove they were working or lose insurance coverage starting Jan. 1. Now, it will let states wait until July.

items.description: As market uncertainty deepens, investment banks are on a roadshow to sell investors on what could be the largest public offering ever.

items.description: A prolonged outage left many without email and other services, the most recent reminder that the world’s technological underpinnings rely on just a few companies.

items.title: Why Jensen Huang Was Essential to Nvidia’s Rise
items.description: Jensen Huang was the driving force at Nvidia, with 60 direct reports and no clear succession plan. Tripp Mickle, one of our technology reporters, examines Mr. Huang’s central role in the company and the artificial intelligence industry.

items.title: Microsoft’s Global Outage and Fixes: What We Know
items.description: The company described “encouraging” progress on efforts to overcome a second day of disruptions to its email, messaging and other services.

items.title: Asian Americans Share Disappointment and Fear After Jensen Huang Scandal
items.description: Many East Asians said that he had swagger and seemed like a superhero. Now there are worries that the spy scandal turns into hyper scrutiny against them.

items.title: Wall Street Loses a Powerful Dealmaker After Nvidia’s CEO Is Ousted
items.description: The ousted Nvidia chief executive was the consummate dealmaker leading the trillion-dollar A.I. build out.
